name: Paint.NET (4.2.16 classic)
summary: The last .NET-Framework release (4.2.16) works with .NET 4.8 installed by winetricks; Paint.NET 5.x does not.
notes:
Paint.NET is a .NET application. Version 4.2.16 (the last release built on the .NET Framework) installs and runs through Wine once .NET Framework 4.8 is in the C:\ drive - this recipe installs it with winetricks (a large download, 10-20 minutes; the installer windows must be clicked through). Layers, adjustments, effects, plug-ins (Effects/FileTypes DLLs) and the standard file formats work. Paint.NET 4.3 and 5.x target .NET 5/7/9 (modern .NET, WPF/Direct2D UI); their installers either fail to download the runtime or the program crashes at start under Wine, so we call this recipe 'partial': use 4.2.16 (available from the getpaint.net 'Classic' download or the archive) and turn off automatic updates in Settings.
Known issues on 4.2.16: hardware acceleration must be off (Settings > UI > untick 'Hardware acceleration'), some effects that use Direct2D show blank previews, and the first start takes a while (.NET native-image generation).
Native alternatives on Lindos: Pinta (a Paint.NET-inspired editor), GIMP, Krita.

alternatives.name: Pinta
alternatives.how: native, Paint.NET-like editor: apt install pinta or Flatpak com.github.PintaProject.Pinta

alternatives.name: GIMP
alternatives.how: native, free: Lindos Settings > Apps > Store, or: apt install gimp
